headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: VER (8)

summary: Lando Norris won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix from pole position, 5.8s ahead of Carlos Sainz, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Charles Leclerc made the biggest climb, from P19 to P3.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P10.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised VER (10 second time penalty), BOT (10 second time penalty), PIA (10 second time penalty), ZHO (5 second time penalty) and STR (5 second time penalty).
There were 28 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 63 points over Lando Norris.
